📊 Understanding HKM Budget System

🎯 What is Budget?

Budget is a financial allocation for a specific accounting dimension (Cost Center, Project, Cost Head, etc.) for a fiscal year. It helps track and control expenses.

📝 How to Set a Budget:
  1. Select Accounting Dimension: Choose Cost Center, Project, or any custom dimension where you want to allocate budget
  2. Set Fiscal Year: Select the financial year for this budget
  3. Enter Budget Amount: Specify the total amount allocated
  4. Save: The system will automatically track utilization
💰 Budget Utilization Components:
  • Payment Entries: Direct payments made via Payment Entry
  • Unpaid Purchase Invoices: Outstanding invoices not yet paid (includes both stock and non-stock items)
  • Stock Expenses: Stock consumption/issue expenses from Stock Entry
  • Purchase Orders: Committed amounts in POs not yet invoiced or paid
  • Additional Expenses: Other GL entries like Journal Entries
⚠️ Important Notes:
  • Purchase at Invoice Level: Budget is utilized when Purchase Invoice is created (not when stock is issued)
  • Asset Purchases: Assets are counted immediately at purchase, not when depreciated
  • Stock Tracking: Stock expenses are shown separately to help identify stock consumption patterns
  • Auto-Calculation: Utilization updates automatically on each transaction
  • Available Amount: Shows remaining budget (Budget Amount - Utilization)
📈 Monitoring Budget:
  • View Budget Variance Report to see all budgets with detailed breakdown
  • Check Utilization Breakdown section to see component-wise expenses
  • Monitor Stock Expenses separately to ensure proper stock management
  • Set alerts when budget exceeds certain threshold
🔍 Example Scenario:

Budget: ₹10,00,000 for "Vrindavan Yatra" (Cost Head)
Utilization:
- Payment Entries: ₹3,00,000 (direct payments made)
- Unpaid Invoices: ₹2,00,000 (invoices pending payment)
- Stock Expenses: ₹1,50,000 (materials issued from stock)
- Purchase Orders: ₹1,00,000 (POs not yet invoiced)
- Additional: ₹50,000 (other adjustments)
Total Utilization: ₹8,00,000
Available: ₹2,00,000

💡 Tip: Regularly review the Budget Variance Report to stay on top of your budget allocations and prevent overspending.
